title: 🔥 Shocking Mine Lamp Secret That Killed 100s!
description:
You won’t believe how miners lit their lamps… and risked instant death 😳 Watch till end!

Before electricity, miners created gas using water + special rocks to light their lamps. Sounds smart, right? But coal mines were filled with explosive gases… and one small flame could trigger a deadly blast. This shocking old-school “hack” cost hundreds of lives.
